text:
Maya (sec): Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — I'm consolidating the remediation owners and short timelines so we can track recurring authz/token issues. Please ack and add any constraints.

Maya (sec): Action list I pulled together:
• token_validation: update library + server-side enforcement -> owner: Samir -> by 2026-04-06
• admin_perm_guard: add explicit gating + tests -> owner: Dina -> by 2026-04-08
• audit_logs: unify schema, add missing event types (token.issue, token.revoke) -> owner: Oliver -> by 2026-04-10
• secrets_rotation: documented runbook + monthly rotation job -> owner: Priya -> by 2026-04-05
• incident-patterns: monthly trending check + dashboard alert -> owner: SRE-Oncall -> by 2026-04-15

Samir: ack. I'll open a draft PR today: branch `authz/token-strict` and link PR #2187. Will add unit tests around expired/nonce checks. For apps using legacy client we need a migration window — proposing 2 weeks per service.

Dina: ack. For admin_perm_guard I want to add a canary flag for Dedicated customers first, then rollout. @Maya any objections to canary for 2 services initially? :eyes:

Maya (sec): no objections, canary is fine. Please include rollback plan and telemetry slices (by region + plan).

Oliver: ack. For audit_logs I'll add a sample SQL to backfill missing token events:
```
INSERT INTO audit.events (ts, user_id, event_type, metadata)
SELECT ts, user_id, 'token.issue', json_build_object('token_id', token_id)
FROM tmp.missing_token_issues;
```
Also will add retention policy doc and ensure RLS denies non-sec roles from writing sensitive fields.

Priya: ack. Runbook draft lives at: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/secrets-rotation (WIP). I'll create the rotation job in infra next week and tag InfraBot.

InfraBot: Scheduled job created: `monthly-secrets-rotation` starting 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC. Job id: jb_90321. Will post success/failure in #eng-infra channel.

SRE-Oncall: ack. I'll build a simple Grafana panel for "unvalidated token errors" and add an alert if rate > 0.1% of auth attempts per 5m. Also proposing a monthly postmortem cadence for recurring authz incidents.

Samir: quick technical note — we should also validate token signatures at the edge LB for short-circuiting. I can prototype an Envoy filter but need a champion to prioritize.

Dina: happy to champion the canary + edge filter test for two services.

Maya (sec): thanks. Next steps:
• Owners, update the tracking doc with PR links and short test plan by EOD Monday.
• I'll run a weekly 15-min check-in on Tuesdays until all items closed.

Maya (sec): Last ask — everyone add the PR/issue numbers inline in the tracking doc so SRE can wire the alert -> runbook mapping.
